name: OLPC pair-side burn multiplier collapses the OLPC/LABUBU reserve
summary: OLPCToken._update() burns value * decimalsValue from the PancakePair on every pair-to-user transfer and delivers nothing. With decimalsValue set to 7.3e18, the attacker sent dust to the OLPC/LABUBU pair and called skim() repeatedly, burning nearly all of the pair's OLPC, then sold 8.1 OLPC against the collapsed reserve for the pair's LABUBU.
notes: Reset is the owner's setDecimalsValue(7326680472586200649), raising the burn multiplier from 1: with 1, a dust skim burns only dust, so the exploit needed this accounting parameter (rule 10). The token runtime itself never changed since deployment; ownership was renounced afterwards.

LABUBU has no DefiLlama price and the attacker's dump took about half of the LABUBU/WBNB pool's WBNB, so it is valued at the 1,115,903.66 USDT realised in the same transaction (rule 15). The 51.9M OLPC burned from the pair is not valued: OLPC could not be bought from the pair.
